prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"coreWork":"Build and validate a daily crop water-balance calculation engine (FAO Penman-Monteith ET, crop coefficients, soil water-holding capacity) that couples with existing soil-type maps and a parcel database, deliverable before the 2026 irrigation season.","reviews":[{"researcherId":"R0662","verdict":"can_do","reason":"Ilić has directly built and validated a Penman-Monteith-based irrigation scheduling engine with crop coefficients and soil moisture validation for Vojvodina conditions, and integrated it into a decision support tool.","evidence":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07490","field":"abstract","quote":"ET₀ model for generating irrigation recommendations across three growing seasons"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07490","field":"abstract","quote":"irrigation scheduling algorithm was subsequently integrated into a web-based decision support tool"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07497","field":"abstract","quote":"locally determined crop coefficients (Kc) are essential inputs for evapotranspiration-based irrigation scheduling"}],"format":"joint_project"},{"researcherId":"R1047","verdict":"can_do","reason":"Pantelić specialises in FAO Penman-Monteith ET estimation, soil water balance modelling, and CROPWAT/AquaCrop calibration for Vojvodina conditions, and has prior industry collaboration on soil moisture sensing; a contract research engagement fits the pre-2026 deadline and her noted availability for smaller industrial contracts.","evidence":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10775","field":"abstract","quote":"Metoda FAO Penman-Monteith (FAO-PM) smatra se standardnim pristupom za procenu referentne evapotranspiracije"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-06983","field":"abstract","quote":"AquaCrop (FAO version 6.1) was calibrated and validated for sunflower under deficit irrigation conditions"},{"id":"R1047","field":"bio","quote":"modeliranjem vodnog bilansa na nivou parcele, procenom referentne evapotranspiracije metodom FAO Penman-Monteith"}],"format":"contract_research"},{"researcherId":"R0579","verdict":"cannot","reason":"Filipović's work centres on soil salinisation, solonetz reclamation, and salt balance modelling, not on building ET-based crop water-balance calculation engines.","evidence":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06706","field":"abstract","quote":"SALTMOD water and salt balance model was calibrated and validated for two contrasting solonetz sites"},{"id":"R0579","field":"keywords","quote":"soil salinisation, alkalisation, solonetz reclamation, gypsum amendment, reclamation drainage"}],"format":""},{"researcherId":"R0240","verdict":"cannot","reason":"Vranješ focuses on groundwater–surface water interaction, bank filtration, and aquifer recharge, not on crop ET modelling or irrigation scheduling engines.","evidence":[{"id":"R0240","field":"keywords","quote":"bank filtration, alluvial aquifer, groundwater–surface water interaction, Pannonian Plain"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03044","field":"abstract","quote":"estimate annual groundwater recharge in a 420 km² agricultural catchment"}],"format":""},{"researcherId":"R0765","verdict":"cannot","reason":"Stanković's expertise is satellite remote sensing, machine learning, and EO data pipelines; she does not build process-based ET or soil water-balance calculation engines.","evidence":[{"id":"R0765","field":"keywords","quote":"Sentinel-2, crop yield prediction, hyperspectral imaging, time series, soil moisture"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08411","field":"abstract","quote":"data-fusion workflow that combines Sentinel-1 C-band backscatter with Sentinel-2 surface reflectance"}],"format":""}]}
